c74object.name: evi_crossover
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. A choice of 2 or 4 pole Linkwitz-Riley crossover filters
c74object.description:
evi_crossover is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_crossover.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_crossovers.genexpr
evi_crossover is also available in MSP as: evi.crossover~.
Linkwitz-Riley crossovers sum perfectly flat on recombination of the outputs. Use evi.crossover~ to achieve multiband processing. @see the 'seealso' section for other evieve objects that can help with this.

geninlet.name: input
geninlet.digest: to Split. Audio input to split.

geninlet.name: crossover
geninlet.digest: Frequency in Hz @min 10 @max 20000. The frequency at which to split the incoming audio into it's lowpass and highpass outputs.

attribute.name: order
attribute.description: 0=2-pole (shallower) crossover filters, 1=4-pole (steeper) crossover filters. 2-pole can be subtle, 4-pole gives more rejection.
